fact: The manual states that the health-centre SIS officer enters the centre's and the community's monthly reports into DHIS2, and that completeness and timeliness stood at 93 per cent and 75 per cent in 2017.
title: Manuel des normes et procédures de gestion du SNIS, 2ème édition
publisher: Ministère de la Santé Publique et de la Lutte contre le SIDA, DSNIS
